spec:S81-07.summary:
Spec written (74,840 B, pure ASCII, LF, 0 bytes >127). Measured at 6b909e0a; git status --short is empty before and after. Main findings:
(1) The 12 live text sites can be built offline by the app's own prompt builders. A capture seam on llm_router.route produced all 12 captures with 0 sockets, and each converted through to_claude_request.
(2) Three import-time hazards: extraction_service:5 and url_extraction_service:6 call load_dotenv(override=True) (2 calls intercepted); openai_service.py:38 builds an AsyncOpenAI at import and raises with no key; cache_service.py:166 builds an Upstash client when both UPSTASH names are set. The harness neutralises dotenv, refuses those names and re-scans the environment after its imports.
(3) SDK anthropic 1.12.1 runs on httpx2 2.12.0. ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS is applied even with an explicit key, so the harness refuses every ANTHROPIC_* name by prefix. str(exc) carries the response body, so errors are recorded by type and status only. exc.response.request.headers holds the key. DefaultAsyncHttpxClient mounts environment and registry proxies even with trust_env=False, so the harness passes its own httpx2.AsyncClient(trust_env=False, follow_redirects=False). max_retries=0 sends exactly 1 request.
(4) No site streams (guarded_anthropic_create:968), so TTFT is measured by an A2 stream twin.
(5) The critique site has no caller since S81-22b, so CRITIC is NOT RUNNABLE.
(6) shadow_experiments reads its inputs from L2 Supabase, so the verdict eval uses only its offline scoring pattern to label a synthetic 60-case gold set.
(7) Worst-case spend bounds: text about 1.50, moderation about 0.28, vision about 3.04, web_search about 0.64 USD. The 4/2/5/3 defaults are kept (sum 14 <= 15).
Base pins: 264 passed, 1 skipped, 2 deselected.

No pytest was run, so the spec 1.10 base record is NOT re-measured. git status --short was empty before and after.
refuted_claims: RC1 verdict_fallback cannot be captured by 'raise a non-LLM exception'. extraction_service.py:2710-2722 reaches route('verdict_fallback') only when str(err) contains 429/rate/quota AND verdict_model != standard_model(). Even then, :2738-2741 calls client.with_options on the seam's object() before route and raises AttributeError. The request would also be byte-identical to verdict's: SITES llm_router.py:217-218 are equal and to_claude_request drops the model at :745-751.

RC2 L1's 'stage V about 3.04, defaults hold with headroom' is false. The spec's own bound, computed with the base functions, is Sonnet vision_v2 0.0333 + v1 >= 0.0183 + Haiku 0.0026 per photo, so 100 photos come to >= 5.42 USD, which is over the 5.00 vision max_usd. R13's 'worst total <= max_usd' fails for a real set (llm_spend_breaker.py:153, :412-422).
RC3 image_tier3 is not a Phase-2 leg with reviews. image_url is in _PHASE1_TIMEOUTS (structured_comparison_service.py:6026), with specs and price.
RC4 'tail = p95(verdict) x 1.25' misreads the knob. _tail_reserve_seconds (scs:1897-1906) is the Phase-1-end -> moderation span (reviews + scoring + verdict), measured at 6.1 s.
RC5 M44 (_scrub not applied) is an equivalent survivor. No designed path writes the key into an output, so R08 and R10 cannot kill it.
RC6 M37 (len(value) printed) survives. R29 runs the report stage, which reads no key, and R08's 6-char substring check cannot see a decimal length.
RC7 Every R row is refused at 2.3 step 3. tests/_env_safety.py:152-156 CREDENTIAL_PLACEHOLDERS keeps OPENAI_API_KEY present in every test process, and the spec never says to delete it.

RC8 R11's static rule contradicts 2.3 step 7. The placeholder store os.environ['OPENAI_API_KEY'] is an os.environ[X] with a literal, and the moderation save/restore must read guarded_anthropic_create.
RC9 The bar 'every site p99 < 25.0 s' is vacuous. CALL_TIMEOUT_S 25.0 is the client timeout, so slower calls become errors and never latency samples.

RC10 The parity set does not model the production moderation input. content_safety_service.py:252-253 moderates _l3_text (scs:4848-4860: verdict prose + names + 10 review highlights) and L4 brand/name/size strings (image_routes.py:457), not short shopping texts.
RC11 P06 'skipped-as-RED' does not meet the rule that RED rows fail on an AssertionError at base.
RC12 2.5(d) prices 'from resp.usage', which is undefined for the A2 stream kind: an AsyncStream has no resp.usage.

C2 Reserve worst_usd in memory before each concurrent send. Add a row (4 concurrent fakes, a cap that fits 3 worst cases -> exactly 3 creates) and a matching mutant.
C3 Book worst_usd for a timeout, an APIConnectionError or any failure after the send. Book 0 only for the API errors the spec lists as unbilled (the R-S04-3 rule).
C4 Append and fsync an intent line before each send. On read-back, an unmatched intent counts at worst_usd; an unparsable ledger line refuses the start.
C5 Price a stream from the message_start usage plus the last message_delta usage; an interrupted stream books worst_usd.
C6 Drop verdict_fallback (stated limit) or rule a real-branch seam.
C7 Give every text site >= 20 calls ('once each' means per round) and re-count max_calls (622 without fallback).
C8 A1 phases: Phase 1 = specs/price/image_tier3, Phase 2 = reviews, then verdict. Use gather(return_exceptions=True) and cancel pending tasks on a stop.
C9 R rows delete OPENAI_API_KEY and set the CANARY key. R03/R04 run with the key present.
C10 R11 checks Load-context reads only, allows exactly one OPENAI_API_KEY store, and allows the moderation save/restore attributes.
C11 P06 asserts the fixture exists at base.
C12 Restore the dotenv bindings (both are replaced over the conftest guard) and OPENAI_API_KEY in finally, with a row that proves it.

C13 Kill M44 with a fake that returns the CANARY in content (expect redactions == 1). Kill M37 with the results.json closed key set and the exact REPORT line. Use a run-time random hex canary and a 4-char substring window.
C14 Count timeouts as +inf in the latency percentiles, or add a timeout_rate bar.
C15 Measure the tail proposal on the reviews -> verdict chain, or state it as a verdict-only lower bound; source or drop the VERDICT latency bar.
C16 Build the moderation set in the _l3_text and L4 shapes, with sensitive-looking fragrance names and Arabic. With n = 80, the FP bar means zero false positives.
C17 Raise the vision max_usd to >= 5.5 (unit sum 14.5) or run Sonnet on vision_v2 only. Restate L1 and add a 100-photo dry-run row.
C18 Restate the garbled TEXT refusal bar. Send the sensitive and Arabic names through the verdict builder too.

blocking: B1 Stage M swallows every stop. _moderate_step (llm_router.py:1164-1181) catches Exception, so budget, auth and transient stops become fail-closed 'unavailable' cases. A 401 is retried for every case, and a budget stop fakes a MODERATION NO-GO.

B2 The spend ceiling is not hard. A1 sends concurrently with no reservation. Exceptions after the send book 0 even though a timeout can be billed, and resume re-sends them. The ledger is written after the response, so a kill or interrupt loses billed spend. Stream pricing is undefined.
B3 verdict_fallback cannot be captured as specified (with_options on object(); the 429/rate/quota condition), and its request equals verdict's.
B4 RED cannot be satisfied as written: the conftest OPENAI_API_KEY placeholder refuses every row, R11 contradicts the spec's own step 7, and P06 is a skip at base.
contract_risks: K1 The live run has no host guard: only tests and dry-run enforce 'api.anthropic.com only'. SUPABASE_*/SERPER_*/SENTRY_DSN are not refused, yet eleven app modules are imported.
K2 The ops shell's ENABLE_* state shapes the measured prompts (verdict blocks at extraction_service.py:2660-2690) and is neither stripped nor recorded.
K3 The unit ceiling is scoped to one --out folder, so a second folder resets it. The relay must fix one --out; the Console spend limit is the only backstop.
K4 Setting the key from an ops agent's Bash call writes it into that transcript (L10). The owner's own terminal or a getpass source is needed.
K5 A Claude Code shell may carry ANTHROPIC_* names. The harness refuses them (the safe direction), but the relay command must unset them.
K6 Stage W uses web_search_20260318, but S81-21 (PLAN_S81.md:165) designs on web_search_20250305.
K7 A6 measures adherence to scores_summary, not verdict quality; REPORT must say so.
K8 Nothing pins that this script stays the only Messages dispatch outside guarded_anthropic_create: the u3c chokepoint pin scans app/ only.
